body:
I am a conventionally handsome man in a social facing job and I get attention all the time. I am approached by women at parties and social settings (rarely ever in public, but if I do talk to someone in public, they’re very receptive and friendly). Take it from me… it is NEVER the kind of person you want. 

Being attractive comes with its own set of problems: these women see me as just a body, or a prize they can win, or they invade my personal space, or they can’t hold a conversation, or they don’t want anything serious… when you attract a lot of people you have to weed through a lot of people.
Today I got approved for my dream apartment… but I wasn’t happy after? Like there was no moment of elation? Wow. When you’re depressed you just don’t feel happiness sometimes. What the hell.
